value.rationale: The fourth-order observable distinguishes early directional platykurtosis from universal eventual leptokurtosis in a specifically motivated anomalous active-transport model. The complete sharp order-versus-dimension boundary predicts when a sign reversal must occur, including the exactly solvable one-dimensional threshold 1/2 and its large-d asymptotic. This is not a second-moment scaling restatement or a numerical slice: it is an analytic classification across all positive dimensions and every fractional order, with clear experimentally interpretable higher-moment measurement.
